result:
Defect 1 (the right-column overlap) is already gone on HEAD v34.31. Defect 2 (the doubled warning) is still there, so I shipped nothing.

- **Overlap (screen 34):** Nothing overlaps at 1080p. The right column has no two text boxes touching, and the 4K picture scales the same way. I did not shoot P2, because the layout code has no per-seat branch. No fix needed.
- **Doubled warning (screen 33):** The warning now shows twice, not three times. "the pillbox has seen you" is a red banner plus a row in the left feed. "location revealed" and "running slowly" are each a top-centre row plus a left feed row. The cause is his 10-15 order (cw-feedall) that everything said on screen also goes into the feed. Removing the copies would reverse that order, so I left them. The question is open in `questions.md` (question 91), and it is not blocking.
- **Critic scores:** Both screens scored 2 on the HEAD pictures, so neither reached 4. Both scores are recorded in `notes/ui/accept.json`.
  - **34:** The downed card is a flat box instead of the standard panel, and the run info rows wrap.
  - **33:** The warning is shown twice, and the controls cheat-sheet sits in the centre of the screen.
- **Left for a later task:** Restyle the downed card as the standard panel with a danger top tab, and fix the run info wrap.

Notes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/106-ui-raid-column-overlaps.md`.

NEXT: the restyled downed card and the run info wrap are the next work for this screen, if a later run takes them.
